item.title: Anthropic Raises $81.3B in IPO as Founders Cash Out Nearly $2B
item.description:
Anthropic completed one of the largest IPOs on record, raising $81.3 billion in total, with its seven co-founders selling roughly 3.4 million shares each at $83 to collectively cash out nearly $2 billion. The company also disclosed $1.05 trillion to $1.08 trillion in future infrastructure commitments, underscoring the capital intensity of frontier model development.

原文标题：Anthropic 上市募资 813 亿美元 七位创始人套现近 20 亿

Why it matters：头部大模型公司完成史上最大规模 IPO 之一，创始人套现与万亿级算力承诺共同揭示前沿 AI 的资本结构。

item.title: SageMaker Inference 2026 Update Adds Cross-Region Routing and GPU Sharing
item.description:
AWS reviewed its 2026 SageMaker Inference updates, including new routing strategies for HyperPod Inference, broader model-serving framework support and expanded multi-Region networking, with the Inference Gateway handling routing and managed NVIDIA Dynamo added as a new serving framework. For managed endpoints, inference recommendations now run from SageMaker AI Studio, the Python SDK and coding agents, and endpoints can route requests across Regions and accounts, helping teams re-select configurations after traffic shifts, pack more models onto paid-for GPUs and fix idle capacity across Regions.

原文标题：SageMaker 推理 2026 升级 支持跨区域路由与多模型共享 GPU

Why it matters：这是 AWS 推理基础设施的年度能力盘点，涉及跨区域路由、GPU 多模型共享与托管 Dynamo，对部署大模型服务的工程团队有直接参考价值。

item.title: Moonshot Adds Native Amazon Bedrock Provider to Kimi Code CLI
item.description:
Moonshot AI released Kimi Code CLI v2.7.0, adding a native Amazon Bedrock provider so the open source coding agent can authenticate through the standard AWS credential chain, including named profiles and SSO, instead of a separately managed Bedrock API key. The walkthrough uses Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed, which supports streaming, configurable reasoning, image input and client-side tool calling.

原文标题：Kimi Code CLI 2.7.0 原生接入 Amazon Bedrock

Why it matters：开源编码智能体打通 AWS 标准凭证链，对在 Bedrock 上跑 Kimi 模型的团队有直接工程价值。

item.title: Google Lets Agents Rewrite Their Own Harness to Boost Task Success Eightfold
item.description:
Google researchers propose a self-improving harness architecture in which an optimizer model directly edits the agent's runtime framework code, keeping only changes that pass validation. On 40 SWE-bench Lite tasks, the modular approach lifted success from 5.0% to 40.0% at roughly 46.7K tokens per task, far below the 451.6K tokens needed for unconstrained full rewrites. The paper also flags risks of prompt bloat, benchmark overfitting and evaluator tampering.

原文标题：谷歌让智能体自改 Harness 任务成功率提升 8 倍

Why it matters：首次系统验证智能体可自改运行框架代码并获得 8 倍任务成功率提升，为 Agent 工程化提供新范式。

item.title: Google to Roll Out Global Android Developer Verification in 2027
item.description:
Google will globally roll out Android developer identity verification in January 2027, covering Google Play plus six major OEM app stores including Samsung, Honor, OPPO, vivo, Xiaomi and Transsion. After fierce developer backlash following its August 2025 announcement, Google softened sideloading restrictions and added a risk-confirmation flow for advanced users installing apps from unverified developers.

原文标题：谷歌 2027 年全球推行 Android 开发者验证

Why it matters：影响整个 Android 应用分发与侧载生态的平台级政策落地，开发者需提前规划合规注册。

item.title: China Smart Glasses Sales Double as Embodied Robot Demand Rises 25 Percent
item.description:
China's Ministry of Commerce reported that smart glasses sales on major platforms doubled year over year in January-October 2026, while embodied AI robots grew 25.2% and exoskeleton assist devices rose 44.4%, signaling AI hardware as a real growth driver in new-type consumption. New energy passenger vehicle retail penetration reached 67.5% in October, with smart and green consumption expanding under trade-in subsidy policies.

原文标题：商务部数据：智能眼镜销售额翻倍 具身机器人增长 25.2%

Why it matters：官方宏观数据首次量化 AI 硬件消费增速，为具身智能与智能眼镜的落地节奏提供可验证的产业侧证据。

item.title: Ex-Anthropic Researcher Predicts 80% Cognitive Labor Automation by 2028
item.description:
Jacob Coxon, a former Anthropic and OpenAI researcher, predicted at Y Combinator's first debate that 80% of cognitive labor will be automated by the end of 2028, framing it as task-level rather than job-level replacement. His extrapolation rests on Anthropic's reported 26% automation rate in core research, a single internal metric rather than systematic evidence.

item.title: AWS Lets AI Agents Buy Marketplace Products via AgentCore
item.description:
AWS extended Bedrock AgentCore payments to AWS Marketplace, letting agents autonomously discover and purchase x402-enabled software, APIs, data, and content, with charges billed in USD directly to the developer's AWS bill and no stablecoin wallets or API keys required. Developers can automate discovery via the Marketplace connector in AgentCore Gateway and enforce per-session spending caps and approved seller lists through AgentCore policy, with all transactions auditable in CloudTrail and Cost Explorer.

item.title: Overmind Launches Chat-Based Model Fine-Tuning via Grok on Mobile
item.description:
Overmind launched an MCP-based fine-tuning service that lets users upload labeled data and trigger training by chatting with Grok on a phone. Overmind's own GPUs fine-tune Qwen3.5-0.8B, then evaluate both the original and tuned models on held-out test rows and return scores to Grok. The workflow wraps dataset reading, training and evaluation as MCP tools, lowering the barrier to customizing small models.

原文标题：Overmind 推出手机端对话式微调小模型服务

Why it matters：展示了 MCP 工具调用驱动端到端微调闭环的实用范式，对关注智能体工具链的读者有参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic Surges 17% in Record IPO to $1.27 Trillion Valuation
item.description:
Anthropic listed on Nasdaq on November 19 at an $83 IPO price and closed its first day at $97.17, up 17.07%, for a market cap of roughly $1.27 trillion. The offering raised $81.3 billion, surpassing SpaceX to become the largest IPO on record. The premium is underpinned by annualized revenue above $81 billion and more than 11,900 enterprise customers spending over $100,000 a year, though EPS of -$59.62 shows the company remains deeply unprofitable.

原文标题：Anthropic 上市首日涨 17% 市值达 1.27 万亿美元

Why it matters：AI 基础模型公司史上最大规模 IPO 落地，是行业资本化进程的标志性节点。

item.title: Kong Launches Volcano Cloud Platform Built for AI Agents
item.description:
Kong has released Volcano, a cloud platform purpose-built for AI agents, bundling hosting, Postgres, authentication, storage, sandboxes and long-running workflows so agents built with Claude Code, Cursor or Codex can be deployed directly. Its centerpiece LavaFlow monitors the live app and codebase, diagnoses failures and submits fixes via GitHub, enabling self-healing operations. The platform targets agent workloads that run for hours, wait on humans or fail midway, which conventional request-oriented hosting handles poorly.

原文标题：Kong 推出 Volcano 智能体云平台

The central tension is balancing teams' freedom to innovate quickly against enterprise-wide standards for safety, security, composability and cost efficiency, lest the organization fragment into AI islands.

item.title: Nvidia Stock Plunges 40 Percent Despite Blockbuster Q3 Earnings

Yet the stock fell nearly 40 percent from its October 6 peak, erasing a brief post-earnings pop, signaling deep investor anxiety over the durability of AI chip demand. Meanwhile, major customer Anthropic debuted on Nasdaq at $111.50 per share, 34 percent above expectations.

item.title: US Tech Outages Expose Fragility of AI-Driven Operations
item.description:

The article argues these failures stem not from AI hackers but from insufficient operational resilience during AI-driven infrastructure transformation, creating opportunities for firms that help organizations move at AI speed without breaking things.

item.title: Google Study Finds Gated Modular Edits Cut Agent Harness Token Cost by 90%
item.description:
A new Google study finds that self-improving agent harnesses work best when an optimizer model edits one code module at a time under validation and token caps, rather than performing an unchecked full rewrite. On 40 held-out SWE-bench Lite tasks, the gated approach reached 40.0% accuracy at 46.7k tokens per task, versus 42.5% at 451.6k tokens for a full rewrite, nearly 10x the cost. Enforcing rules via prompts instead of code collapsed accuracy to 2.5%.

原文标题：谷歌研究：智能体框架模块化改写省 90% token

Why it matters：给出了自改进智能体框架的可复现工程结论：模块化门控改写能以近十分之一成本逼近全量重写效果，对构建 agent 系统的团队有直接指导价值。

item.title: PostgreSQL 19 Ships with Read-Your-Writes Consistency via WAIT FOR LSN
item.description:
PostgreSQL 19 has shipped roughly two months later than its usual September cadence, largely because the team had to work through a surge of AI-assisted vulnerability reports. The headline feature is the new WAIT FOR LSN command, which lets a standby session wait until WAL replay reaches a given LSN before querying, enabling read-your-writes consistency on read replicas.

原文标题：PostgreSQL 19 发布 新增 WAIT FOR LSN 读己之写一致性

Why it matters：主流开源数据库的重要版本更新，新增的读己之写一致性能力对读写分离架构有直接工程价值。
